result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation in a food delivery app interface. The main issues are horizontally cut-off cards in carousels and inconsistent heart icon styling.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only partial content and truncated text ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: This is likely intentional to indicate horizontal scrolling, but ensure enough of the next card is visible or add a visual scroll indicator. Verify the truncation is by design and not a rendering error.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons in the 'Popular right now' section have inconsistent styling. The first card (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) has a white heart outline on dark background, while the second card (pizza) has a heart on a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and style across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, showing only the top portion of the card without its title or details.
issues.suggestion: This is expected scroll behavior, but ensure adequate padding at the bottom of the scrollable content so cards aren't obscured by the fixed navigation bar.
